title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime Casts Shōya Ishige
content: The official website for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced on Thursday that the anime has cast Shōya Ishige as Johann, a son of a noble house in Marronnier's western territory.
author: ANN

title: Voice Actors Kouji Yusa and Miyari Nemoto Announce Marriage
content: Voice actors Kouji Yusa and Miyari Nemoto revealed their marriage through personal statements posted on social media on Thursday. Nemoto shared the news on her X account, writing, "It is with great humility that I announce my marriage registration with Kouji Yusa.

title: Naruto’s New Manga Return Will Make Boruto Obsolete
content: The Naruto franchise is planning to expand in a way that hints at trouble for the official sequel, Boruto , and its current manga installment, Two Blue Vortex . The original Naruto manga wrapped up its narrative with a perfect ninja story, leaving no loose ends that necessitated a sequel.
